question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Q4 guidance: revenue +9-11% YoY (~$113B), gross margin 47-48% including ~1pt tariff-refund benefit, rising memory costs. Simple model gives ~$2.00 EPS. Consensus is ~$1.99 (MarketBeat; some sources $2.02-2.07). Apple has beaten consensus ~3-7% recently (Q4 FY25 1.85 vs 1.77; Q3 FY26 2.02 vs 1.89, incl. $0.11 refund). Median set ~4% above consensus at $2.07. Small tail for a one-off GAAP charge (e.g., 2024 EU tax charge cut Q4 EPS to $0.97). No exact-match prediction market found (Polymarket only had a prior-quarter beat contract).
calls.dossier:
- Apple Q3 FY26 (qtr ended Jun 27 2026, reported Jul 30 2026): GAAP diluted EPS $2.02, +29% YoY, includes ~$0.11 favorable tariff-refund impact (Apple newsroom/8-K). Revenue $109.4B, net income $29.8B. Consensus was ~$1.89 (digitalapplied, tradingpedia).
- Q3 FY26 gross margin 50.1%; tariff refund added >2pts. Opex $19.1B, +23% YoY (digitalapplied).
- Q4 FY26 guidance (Jul 30 2026): revenue +9-11% YoY incl ~2.5pt FX headwind and more supply constraints on iPhone/Mac/iPad; gross margin 47-48% incl ~1pt tariff-refund benefit; memory costs rising further (quartr/investing.com transcript summaries).
- Year-ago Q4 FY25: EPS $1.85, revenue ~$102.5B. Q4 FY24 was $0.97 because of a one-time ~$10B EU State Aid tax charge, which shows GAAP one-off tail risk.
- Consensus Q4 FY26 EPS: MarketBeat $1.99 (Oct 20 2026; rev $113.3B); 27-analyst range $1.93-2.07; another source $2.02 on rev $115.1B; another $2.07 (range 1.99-2.15).
- Beat history: Q4 FY25 1.85 vs ~1.77 (+4.5%); Q3 FY26 2.02 vs 1.89 (+7%, refund-aided). Apple typically beats by 2-7%.
- Simple model: rev ~$113B x 47.5% GM = ~$53.7B GP, minus opex ~$18.7B, tax ~16-17%, diluted shares ~14.6B gives ~$2.00.
- Status quo: report in line with guidance plus a typical beat. Report date listed as Oct 28 or Nov 2 2026; resolves off GAAP diluted EPS in the initial 8-K release.
- Event window: first quarterly release after Sep 30 2026 (Apple Q4 FY26, qtr ending ~Sep 26 2026); quarter is over, report pending as of Oct 25 2026.
- Markets: no Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold contract on Q4 FY26 EPS level found.
- Not found: explicit Q4 opex/tax-rate guidance figures; any pre-announcement or new one-time charge.

calls.reasoning: Consensus for Apple's Q4 FY26 (Sept quarter) diluted EPS is about $1.99–2.00, with a range of $1.93–2.07. The year-ago figure was $1.85. Apple guided to 9–11% revenue growth and 47–48% gross margin, and flagged worsening SoC supply constraints. Apple has beaten consensus in 8 of the last 8 quarters, with a median beat near 4–5%, which puts my median around $2.07. GAAP figures can include one-offs in either direction: the June quarter's GAAP $2.02 included $0.11 of tariff refunds, while Q4 FY24 GAAP was $0.97 because of the EU state-aid tax charge. That second case is the mechanism behind a small below-range escape. I found no Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold market on this.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: consensus $1.99 (range 1.93-2.07), guidance (rev +9-11%, GM 47-48% incl ~1pt refund), year-ago $1.85, 8-10 straight beats with median ~4.5%. The apparent conflict over the Q3 FY26 surprise (2.02 vs 1.89 in Run 1; 1.91 vs 1.88 on AlphaQuery) comes from AlphaQuery excluding the $0.11 tariff refund, so the facts agree. Guidance includes the refund benefit, so consensus most likely already does too. The remaining differences (median 2.07 vs 2.075, width 0.17-0.19) are judgment calls; I take a median of ~2.066 and width 0.19, slightly heavier on the downside because of the flagged supply and memory-cost pressure. No web access on this run.
